Third-party notices for 一呼（Yihu） iOS Qwen3-ASR

Pure Core ML inference code is derived from soniqo/speech-swift commit
ca4daaf9be7cccf230f691e443cd80b7a0bd8d97.
Copyright its contributors; licensed under Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/soniqo/speech-swift

At runtime, the app can download these pinned model assets from the provider
selected in the model download screen. ModelScope is available for mainland
China networks:

- Qwen3-ASR-0.6B base model and tokenizer, Qwen Team / Alibaba Cloud,
  revision 4ce9cc728b473a5aedbe7b6e1ea45646316824dc.
  https://modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B
- Qwen3-ASR Core ML conversion by aufklarer,
  revision 50c8480c626116e21c9353d788762743cd401f24.
  https://modelscope.cn/models/aufklarer/Qwen3-ASR-CoreML

Hugging Face is available as the overseas option:

- Qwen3-ASR-0.6B tokenizer, revision
  5eb144179a02acc5e5ba31e748d22b0cf3e303b0.
  https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B
- Qwen3-ASR Core ML conversion by aufklarer, revision
  8c6bc87b87856930b435550e94ce47de710ce4ed.
  https://huggingface.co/aufklarer/Qwen3-ASR-CoreML

Both model repositories declare the Apache License 2.0. The app uses the
same SHA-256 asset manifest for either provider. The complete license text is
included in LICENSE.txt. Model assets remain in the app's local data container
and are not bundled into the application binary.
